entries.title: Twelve-arc linear population-reserve candidate
entries.source_lifecycle: unreviewed candidate in a draft source PR; imported claim not audited for destination promotion

claim.statement: For every finite planar unit-separated n-point global diameter minimizer with D>16384, g_A=n-1-pi*D^2/(2*sqrt(3)) >= gamma*D-sqrt(D)/(4*sqrt(2))-60, where gamma=3*(576*b-65)/(114695*a) and a=sqrt(3)/2, b=sqrt(3)-98/65. In particular g_A>=D/600 for D>=10^6.
hypotheses: global diameter minimizer
finite planar unit-separated n-point set
D>16384 for the asymptotic formula; D>=10^6 for the convenient effective bound
